dumpDatabase.heading: Delete recognition data
dumpDatabase.description: Permanently deletes the learned card images, for one game or all of them
dumpDatabase.confirmAll: This permanently deletes the recognition data for every game. The scanner won't identify any cards until you re-import the card pack (a few minutes) or run a full sync (several hours).
dumpDatabase.confirmScoped: This permanently deletes the recognition data for {{scope}}. The scanner won't identify those cards until you re-import the card pack (a few minutes) or run a full sync (several hours).
